verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator that drives coding agents such as a Claude subagent through tasks: it creates an isolated worktree, has the agent work, queues the committed candidate, and can loop until no kanban work remains. That covers end-to-end implementation via a delegated agent. However, the actual coding is done by external agents, and the docs treat tests only as explicit project checks run outside merge, with nothing showing agents writing tests. missing for 10: evidence that the agent writes tests as part of the feature, a documented feature-to-tests workflow example, independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.
